Answer one open owner wait, named by its id (Q<N>) or by its card (#<N>): say the words into the owner channel and write one owner.answer request to this repository's bus, which closes the wait on its next tick or says why it did not (construct answer v<version>)

USAGE construct answer [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

   --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)
  --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)
